tech_effects.Ball: +2 VP when you complete an Order
tech_effects.Brickyard: +4 VP when you carry out the Customs action and place an assistant
tech_effects.ElectricalLight: +3 VP when you build a Trading House
tech_effects.Gaslight: +2 VP when you build a Shophouse
tech_effects.LanguageSchool: +1 Yen when you complete an Order
tech_effects.LetterPressPrinting: +1 Yen for each Technology you acquire after this one (never for this card itself)
tech_effects.MiningTechnology: +1 Copper each time you receive 1 or more Copper (once per gain, not per token)
tech_effects.Newspaper: Placement Option A may use 4 different areas instead of 3
tech_effects.PatentSystem: +2 VP for each Technology you acquire after this one (never for this card itself)
tech_effects.PostalSystem: May stop and act where opponent Presidents stand; pay each owner 1 Yen unless you own Stagecoach
tech_effects.SpinningMill: Once per turn: discard 1 Silk to gain 2 Yen
tech_effects.Stagecoach: Move through opponent Presidents fee-free; with Postal System, stopping on one is free too
tech_effects.Station: Place the Station token: +1 Power for all there; free teleport, no President fee; your assistant needed
tech_effects.SystemOfStock: At turn start, if you have 1 Yen or less, refill to 2 Yen
tech_effects.Telegram: After placing 2 assistants in one area, may place 1 in an adjacent area (normal placement fee applies)
tech_effects.Telephone: During Recovery, may leave 1 assistant in the action area
tech_effects.Tram: Teleport the President to any area without an opponent President
tech_effects.University: Once per turn: pay 1 Yen to take an assistant from the Warehouse
tech_effects.Winery: +3 VP when you carry out the Church action and place an assistant
